headline: Nevish Line Rekindles as Expanse Battle Endures
war_summary: Since the afternoon edition Nevish Line has returned to the wires with two fresh transfers at the hour to close forty-two changes on the day about Princefal, Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother, latest at 1806, under seven Warden and one destroyed holding, with 6,232 Colonial and 7,400 Warden casualties on the day. The Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest desk with three changes in two hours, forty-four on the day about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Huntsfort for five Warden, one Colonial and three destroyed holdings, also last at 1806, with 6,270 Colonial and 6,127 Warden casualties on the day. Marban Hollow counts two in two hours, nineteen on the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall for three Warden, three Colonial and two destroyed, last at 1721. Stonecradle shows two fresh at 1616 about the Reach. Linn Mercy, Kuura Strand, Mooring County and Stlican Shelf, lively earlier, have logged nothing in two hours, while Callahan's Passage reports 5,448 Colonial and 3,894 Warden casualties on the day with no recorded transfer.
